title: Rechtsschutz tariff comparison record
description: Normalized, comparable facts extracted from one legal-protection-insurance tariff's document set. Facts only — no verbatim policy text. Use null when a document set does not state a value (do NOT guess).

tariff.description: Tariff / product name as marketed, e.g. 'Aktiv-Rechtsschutz Premium'.

modules.description: Which legal areas are covered, and at which service level (Basis/Komfort/Premium or null if not graded).

versicherungssumme.description: Sum insured per case, e.g. 'unbegrenzt' or '300000 EUR'.

selbstbeteiligung.description: Deductible per case, e.g. '0 EUR', '150 EUR', or 'wählbar 150/300 EUR'.

wartezeit_monate.description: General waiting period in months; 0 if none.

wartezeit_ausnahmen.description: Areas with deviating / no waiting period.

geltungsbereich.description: Geographic scope, e.g. 'Europa + Mittelmeeranrainer; weltweit temporär'.

leistungen.description: Notable covered services / benefits (e.g. 'telefonische Rechtsberatung', 'Mediation', 'Strafkaution als Darlehen').

besonderheiten.description: Distinguishing features worth flagging in a comparison.

beitrag.description: Premium. Usually NOT in AVB/PIB — comes from the check24 result table or a personal offer. Leave null (or all sub-fields null) if absent.

quelle.description: Where the premium came from, e.g. 'check24-Ergebnisliste 2026-06-23'.

sources.description: Provenance: which extracted documents this record was derived from.

level.description: Service variant, or null if the area is not graded.
